keyword.zh: 柴油60和柴油120混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 柴油60和柴油120混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Diesel 60 is one 6105 engine at 144 kW and 35 m³/h. Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW units, 290 kW total, and 100 m³/h.
description.zh: 柴油60是一台 6105、144 kW、35 m³/h。柴油120印两台 145 kW，合计 290 kW，产量 100 m³/h。

h1.zh: 柴油60和柴油120混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 60 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 60 prints one engine line, 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and distance 150 m / 350 m. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW as two units of 145 kW, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, distance 150 m / 500 m and aggregate 6 cm and below. The jump in the model numeral is not itself the output.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油60和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油60印一行发动机 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、距离 150 m / 350 m。柴油120印 290 kW（两台各 145 kW）、100 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 150 m / 500 m、骨料 6 cm 及以下。型号数字的跳跃本身不是产量。

heading.en: Where Diesel 60 and Diesel 120 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油60和柴油120哪些数值不同

body.en: Diesel engine power: Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW; Diesel 120 prints 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Theoretical output: Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h; Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 60 prints 30 MPa; Diesel 120 prints 40 MPa. Hopper capacity: Diesel 60 prints 0.4 m³; Diesel 120 prints 0.6 m³. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 100; Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 (two units). Dimensions: Diesel 60 prints 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW；柴油120印 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。理论输送量：柴油60印 35 m³/h；柴油120印 100 m³/h。最大出口压力：柴油60印 30 MPa；柴油120印 40 MPa。料斗容积：柴油60印 0.4 m³；柴油120印 0.6 m³。液压泵：柴油60印 Kawasaki double pump 100；柴油120印 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。外形尺寸：柴油60印 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm；柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 60 prints cells that Diesel 120 does not: Model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132; Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. Diesel 120 prints cells that Diesel 60 does not: Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Max. aggregate size 6 cm and below. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油60有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。柴油120有、柴油60没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Count the engine units on Diesel 120 before comparing it with the single 6105 line. Open /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60 and /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 拿柴油120和单行 6105 比较之前，先数清柴油120写了几台发动机。看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/，看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 print the same diesel engine power as Diesel 120?
question.zh: 柴油60和柴油120的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW。柴油120印 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 120?
question.zh: 柴油60和柴油120的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60印 35 m³/h。柴油120印 100 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 120?
question.zh: 柴油60和柴油120的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 prints 30 MPa. Diesel 120 prints 40 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60印 30 MPa。柴油120印 40 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on Diesel 120?
question.zh: 为什么柴油120没有型号行？

answer.en: The Diesel 120 page does not print that label. Diesel 60 prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油120这一页没有印这个标题。柴油60印的是 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
